tour.title: Guided tour
tour.intro: Click a building, or start the tour, and the walker routes to it over the road graph.

townHall.name: Town Hall
townHall.description: The north side of the loop. Clicking a landmark asks the navigation graph for a route and the walk is animated along it.

museum.name: Museum
museum.description: The east side. The whole scene shares one container sorted on grid depth, so whatever is nearer the camera is drawn last, water and pavement included.

market.name: Market Hall
market.description: The south side, and where the walker starts. Road tiles are generated from the same graph the walker routes over.

library.name: Library
library.description: The west side. Selection state lives in Redux, and the Pixi scene reads it rather than owning it.
